# Francis Garry Nillama — AI Solutions Engineer

> Portfolio of Francis Garry Nillama, an AI Solutions Engineer based in Cebu, Philippines (BS Information Technology, CIT-U, 2022–2026). He turns business problems into working AI solutions — AI agents on the Claude Agent SDK, Claude/OpenAI API integrations, RAG and document intelligence, and Python automation — and ships them end to end with Next.js/React, TypeScript, Node, Python and Supabase/PostgreSQL. He is open to full-time roles (remote, onsite or relocation) in AI solutions engineering, AI/LLM engineering, automation and full-stack development.

Key facts:

- Location: Cebu, Philippines. Open to remote work, to onsite work, and to relocating.
- Experience (all past roles):
  - Software Engineer / IT Executive Assistant / OJT Mentor at Lifewood Philippines (Jun–Oct 2026).
  - Software Engineering Intern at Lifewood Data Technology (Feb–May 2026).
  - About 2 years as a BPO agent (2022–2024) before that.
- AI / LLM: Claude Agent SDK, Claude Code and subagents, PreToolUse hooks, Model Context Protocol, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, agentic workflow and tool design, prompt and context design, RAG (LangChain, ChromaDB, Ollama, pgvector), OCR (EasyOCR, OpenCV), evaluation and pilot metrics.
- Automation: Python workers and scripting, Selenium, Apify, Power Automate, Microsoft Graph, webhook ingestion.
- Full-stack: Next.js 14/15, React 18/19, TypeScript (strict), Node 22, Express 5, Fastify 5, Django/DRF, PostgreSQL 16 + row-level security, Supabase, Redis, Docker, GitHub Actions, Vercel.
- Certifications: StackTrek AI Prompting for Automation (Level 3, TESDA-aligned, May 2026); Utilize Generative AI; AI Automation Techniques; Data Privacy & Ethics; Accenture Academy AWS (60 hours, Jan 2026).

## Featured AI solutions

- **Lifewood-Nexus.** Sole author of an agentic IT-remediation platform.
  - Problem: a small IT team with a queue of reproducible bugs.
  - Solution: a Python worker on the Claude Agent SDK reproduces, fixes and tests each bug on an isolated git branch behind a PreToolUse-hook gatekeeper; IT reviews and merges.
  - Outcome: delivered in nine phases, including runbooks and a pilot plan with go/no-go metrics.
- **Lifewood AI Agent (V1–V4).** Sole architect of an expense-intelligence platform.
  - Receipt OCR (~2–5 s), categorisation, an analytics dashboard (150–300 ms in production), an LLM agent for plain-language questions, and RAG over PDFs.
  - Shipped across four production releases and presented to the company CEO.
- **AIGC Training-Video Pipeline.** Script-to-master generative-AI video production for enterprise e-learning.
  - Locked character references, Python compositing and tracking for shot-to-shot consistency, word-timed voice-over masters, ffmpeg assembly to 1080p.
  - A panel of specialised Claude Code QC subagents checks every render against script, brand and accessibility rules.
- **Cred-It.** Lead author (team of five) of OCR-based transfer-credit evaluation for the CIT-U College of Computer Studies.
  - EasyOCR + OpenCV extraction and fuzzy matching against curricula, with faculty review.
  - Evaluated with 39 users: System Usability Scale 73.4 against a 68 benchmark.
- **Expense AI Monorepo.** Fully local RAG (LangChain, ChromaDB, Ollama) with a prompt-injection sanitising layer.
- **Pearl27 Automation.** LLM-driven browser automation with guard rails, audit logging and dry-run mode.
- **OLTEK Contract Extraction.** Built for a company hackathon: layered contract extraction (deterministic → layout graph → AI fallback) with per-field confidence scoring.

## Full-stack platforms

- **LifewoodPH HRIS.** Primary engineer (222 of 401 commits) on a company-wide HR information system: intake, leave-credit accrual, RFID attendance, statutory document generation. Next.js 15, Express 5, Supabase Postgres + RLS.
- **AngelHost & Keel.** Lead contributor on AngelHost (212 of 324 commits): a four-transport ingestion core (Power Automate, Microsoft Graph, local sync, manual upload) and property management across eight OTA channels; Keel is an independent sibling on the Channex API.
- **Pulse Dialer.** An independent multi-tenant predictive dialer on Asterisk 22 ARI, Fastify 5 and PostgreSQL 16 with RLS on every table.
- **Lifewood Corporate Website.** SSR Next.js with a Django backend for applicant and admin review workflows.
